title: Worked (JEE Advanced): big sums and powers

board_content.text: Advanced: collapse with the period-4 trick
For $n\ge 4$, $n!$ is a multiple of 4, so $i^{n!}=1$.

segments_english.text: <excited>Now two Advanced-tier problems that look scary but collapse instantly once you use the period-four idea.</excited>
Evaluate the sum S, of i to the power n factorial, as n runs from one to one hundred.
Key observation: as soon as n is four or more, n factorial contains the factor four, so it's a multiple of four, and i to that power is just one.
So only the first three terms are interesting. i to the one factorial is i. i to the two factorial is i squared, minus one. i to the three factorial is i to the six, which is minus one.
So the sum is i minus one minus one, from the first three terms, plus ninety seven ones from the rest. That's i minus two plus ninety seven, which is ninety five plus i.
Second problem: find the least positive integer m for which one plus i over one minus i, all to the power m, equals one.
Simplify the base first. Multiply top and bottom to get one plus i squared over two, which is two i over two, exactly i.
So the condition becomes i to the m equals one, true precisely when m is a multiple of four. The least positive value is four.

segments_hinglish.text: <excited>Ab do Advanced-tier problems jo scary lagte hain par period-four idea use karte hi turant collapse ho jaate hain.</excited>
Sum S nikaalo, i to the power n factorial ka, jahan n one se one hundred tak chalta hai.
Key observation: jaise hi n four ya zyada hota hai, n factorial mein factor four aa jaata hai, to wo multiple of four hai, aur i us power par bas one hai.
To sirf pehle teen terms interesting hain. i to the one factorial hai i. i to the two factorial hai i square, minus one. i to the three factorial hai i to the six, jo hai minus one.
To sum hai i minus one minus one, pehle teen terms se, plus ninety seven ones baaki se. Wo hai i minus two plus ninety seven, jo hai ninety five plus i.
Doosra problem: wo least positive integer m nikaalo jiske liye one plus i over one minus i, poora to the power m, barabar one ho.
Pehle base simplify karo. Top aur bottom multiply karke milta hai one plus i square over two, jo hai two i over two, bilkul i.
To condition ban jaati hai i to the m barabar one, jo tabhi sach hai jab m multiple of four ho. Least positive value hai four.
